span.div:
Node 2 votes: Node 2 (self) + Node 1 = 2 votes
Node 4 votes: Node 4 (self) + Node 3 = 2 votes
Majority needed: 3 votes
Result: Neither candidate reaches majority → Split vote

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Resolution:
Both candidates wait for their election timeout (~150-300ms)
Then:
- Node 2 times out at 180ms → restarts election with term 8
- Node 4 may still be in term 7 → accepts Node 2's RequestVote
- Node 2 receives Node 3 and 4 votes → 4 votes → majority!
Expected delay from split vote: 180ms + network RTT
